# 4K Shooters

> > Professional filmmaking news, reviews, and workflows covering 4K/UHD cameras, production gear, and post-production techniques for independent cinematographers.

4K Shooters is a specialized resource for digital cinematography professionals and enthusiasts, focusing on camera announcements (Sony A7s, RED, Panasonic GH4, Sony FS7), production workflows (ProRes, DNxHD, S-Log2), and emerging 4K/Ultra HD technology. The site covers everything from camera bodies and recording formats to editing systems, storage solutions, and production accessories.

## Key Topics

- 4K/UHD Video Production
- Sony A7s & FS7 Cameras
- Panasonic GH4
- RED Digital Cinema
- ProRes & DNxHD Codecs
- S-Log2 Color Profiles
- GoPro Hero4
- Run-and-Gun Shooting
- Video Editing Workflows
- Camera Announcements
- Blackmagic Design
- Canon 5D Mark III
- Kickstarter Production Gear
- Ultra HD Technology
- DSLR/Mirrorless Video

- [Wolfcrow Examines the Highs and Lows of the 4K Capable Sony A7s](https://www.4kshooters.net/2014/11/01/wolfcrow-examines-the-highs-and-lows-of-the-4k-capable-sony-a7s): Sareesh Sudhakaran's balanced Sony A7s review covering S-Log2 & 4K video
- [RED Teases What Comes After Dragon](https://www.4kshooters.net/2015/02/23/red-teases-what-comes-after-dragon): RED Weapon camera announcement teaser from Jarred Land on REDuser forum
- [GoPro Hero 4 Official Specs: 4K/30fps, Built-in Touch Screen, 1080/120fps](https://www.4kshooters.net/2014/09/26/gopro-hero-4-official-specs-4k30fps-built-in-touch-screen-1080120fps): GoPro Hero 4 Black & Silver specs: 4K/30fps, touchscreen, 1080/120fps
- [ARRI Enables 3.2K ProRes Recording on the ALEXA XT](https://www.4kshooters.net/2014/09/04/arri-enables-3-2k-prores-recording-on-the-alexa-xt): ARRI ALEXA XT firmware upgrade adds 3.2K ProRes & Open Gate recording

## 4K Workflows & Post-Production

- [Popular Non-Linear Editors in 2014 Which Support 4K](https://www.4kshooters.net/2014/07/11/popular-non-linear-editors-in-2014-which-support-4k): 2014 NLE comparison guide covering 4K editing software & workflows
- [How Much Hard Disk Space Do You Need to Shoot in 4K?](https://www.4kshooters.net/2014/06/25/how-much-hard-disk-space-do-you-need-shooting-4k): 4K storage requirements guide covering ProRes, H.264 & backup planning
- [Tips and Tricks on Putting Together A Music Montage](https://www.4kshooters.net/2014/09/24/tips-and-tricks-on-putting-together-a-music-montage): Larry Jordan's video editing tutorial on music montage techniques
- [Panasonic 4K Blu-ray Player & Ultra HD Blu-ray Discs Details From CES 2015](https://www.4kshooters.net/2015/01/09/panasonic-4k-blu-ray-player-ultra-hd-blu-ray-discs-details-from-ces-2015): Panasonic 4K Blu-ray player & Ultra HD disc technology from CES 2015
